title: Morning Evening Clock
hook: Read the clock and the situation together.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D daily-routine storybook, simple home actions and objects, clean morning-evening scenes; visual identity: Morning Evening Clock

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading time cues without ignoring body needs
